description: This file defines an interface named AesStreamInterface in the Aws\Crypto namespace, which extends the PSR-7 StreamInterface. The interface specifies methods related to AES encryption streams, including retrieving the OpenSSL cipher name, AES name, and current initialization vector (IV).

classes.name: AesStreamInterface
classes.description: An interface extending StreamInterface, defining methods for AES encryption stream handling, such as obtaining the OpenSSL cipher name, AES name, and IV.

methods.name: getOpenSslName
methods.description: Returns a string recognizable by openssl_* functions, e.g., 'aes-256-cbc', used for encryption/decryption.

methods.name: getAesName
methods.description: Returns an AES-specific name, such as 'AES/GCM/NoPadding'.

methods.name: getCurrentIv
methods.description: Returns the current IV (initialization vector) used to initialize the next encryption/decryption block.
